healthcare_provider_setting.label: Healthcare-provider setting
healthcare_provider_setting.value: Affiliated skilled nursing facilities and assisted living communities.

patient_activity_volume.label: Patient activity / volume
patient_activity_volume.value: Large annualized volume of unique residents served across affiliated operations.

payer_revenue_mix.label: Payer revenue mix
payer_revenue_mix.value: Medicaid is the largest payer, followed by Medicare and managed care, with additional private-pay and other revenue.

payment_reimbursement_model.label: Payment / reimbursement model
payment_reimbursement_model.value: Per-day skilled nursing reimbursement, with Medicare using the Patient Driven Payment Model and Medicaid and managed care paying under state rates or negotiated contracts.

setting_specific_capacity.label: Setting-specific capacity
setting_specific_capacity.value: Multistate network of affiliated skilled nursing and assisted living locations.

patient_acuity_case_mix.label: Patient acuity / case mix
patient_acuity_case_mix.value: Post-acute residents recovering from illness or regaining function, alongside long-term residents who need ongoing care.

clinical_operating_quality.label: Clinical operating quality
clinical_operating_quality.value: Affiliated skilled nursing operations report high CMS Quality Measure ratings and rehospitalization rates below the national average.

notes: Licensed skilled nursing bed and assisted living unit capacity remain unspecified.
